as_told.title: F. Lee Bailey on CIA retainer (index 4)

plain: In 1973, during the Watergate scandal, the famous defense lawyer F. Lee Bailey was secretly on the CIA's "Index 4," according to the lawyer Dan Sheehan, who says he was close to the case of James McCord, one of the Watergate burglars. Sheehan says Bailey was one of four attorneys the CIA kept on retainer, which would mean the agency had a hand in McCord's defense. In one telling he says he learned this himself, and in another he credits two men, Andy Toney and William Johnstone Taylor, as his sources.
